page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Running text in roman and italic, with the Latin inscriptions set in capitals and italic.

p.i: Inscriptionem, quæ in suprema circumferentia circumcirca aureis etiam legitur literis, præmittemus: & est eiusmodi.

main_text.p: IMPERATORI CÆS. MAXIMILIANO, PIO, FELICI, AVGVSTO, PRINCIPI TVM PACIS, TVM BELLI ARTIBVS OMNIVM AETATIS SVÆ REGVM LONGE CLARISSI-MO; SVB CVIVS FELICI IMPERIO INCLYTA GERMANIA, DVLCISSIMA IPSIVS PATRIA, TAM ARMIS, QVAM LITERARVM STVDIIS, PLVS QVAM ANTE HAC FLORERE, CAPVTQVE SVPER ALIAS NATIONES EXTOLLERE COEPIT. CVIVS INSIGNIA FACTA TABELLIS INFERIORIBVS QVAMVIS SVB COMPENDIO EXPRESSA CONSPICIVNTVR.

p.i: IMPERATOR CÆSAR FERDINANDVS, PIVS, FELIX, AVGVSTVS, AVO PATERNO PERQVAM COLENDO AC BENE MERITO PIETATIS ATQVE GRATITVDINIS ERGO P.

page.notes: The page opens mid-sentence, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The underlines under QVAM, CAPVTQVE, PERQVAM and ATQVE are decorative and are not transcribed. A dark ink blot sits over the "V" in STVDIIS; the letters are still legible and were read as STVDIIS. The line ending "CONSPICIVNTVR" has a trailing mark, which was read as a period.
